purpose: External music and sound effects for the 41 s French promo of StudioVisualIdentity. Files are optional: when a file is missing, build_audio.py falls back to its synthesized music / CC0 sounds.
howToUse: Drop the files, then run: .venv/bin/python out/demo/build.py audio && build.py final 16x9 && build.py final 9x16 (no need to re-render the picture).

music.alignment: starts at t = 0 of the video; trimmed or zero-padded to the duration, last 0.6 s faded out
music.key: A minor (fallback music: Am - F - C - G, one chord per 2 s bar)
music.beatGrid: first downbeat at 3.5 s, then a beat every 0.5 s and a bar every 2.0 s; every cut below sits on this grid
music.style: Instrumental, no vocals (a French voice-over and the shorts' own audio play on top). Punchy modern trailer / tech-promo electronic: tight kick, bass, plucky synth arpeggio, claps. Confident and playful, not dark.
music.mixNote: It is ducked about 7 dB under the voice-over and 3 dB under the shorts' own audio, and loudness-matched to the fallback music, so deliver it full and unducked.

sections.name: hook: template music
sections.direction: Deliberately bland, cheerful stock "template" ukulele/pluck jingle, thin like a phone speaker. Three accents at 0.0, 0.5 and 0.95 s (three words slam on screen).

sections.name: the template breaks
sections.direction: At 2.0 s the jingle tape-stops / glitches out. Then 1.5 s of rising tension (riser, snare roll) into the first drop.

sections.name: carousel build
sections.direction: First drop at 3.5 s: the real groove enters (half-time for one bar, then full four-on-the-floor from 4.5 s). One style card every 0.5 s. From 7.5 to 11.0 s keep it lighter (drums and bass, no lead): the shorts' own audio is featured.

sections.name: carousel: four named styles
sections.direction: Four strong accents exactly at 11.0, 12.0, 13.0 and 14.0 s (the voice names four styles, one card each).

sections.name: carousel spin
sections.direction: The carousel whips a full turn while accelerating: hold back the kick, snare roll and riser building to the wall.

sections.name: 45-shorts wall
sections.direction: Big impact with crash exactly at 16.0 s, second accent at 16.3 s ("45 shorts" slams). Fullest energy so far.

sections.name: the prompt (calm)
sections.direction: Breakdown: no kick, only a soft bass pulse and a pad. Leave room: keyboard typing is heard here.

sections.name: build to the drop
sections.direction: Check marks at 23.0 and 24.0 s. Kick returns on half notes, hats, snare roll from 25.0 s, and a tiny gap of silence (about 0.13 s) right before 26.0 s.

sections.name: DROP: episodes 1, 2, 3
sections.direction: The main drop exactly at 26.0 s (crash, full drums and bass). Accents at 28.0 and 30.0 s (episode changes). Keep the lead sparse: each episode's own audio is featured.

sections.name: four number panels
sections.direction: Four big hits, one per second, at 32.5, 33.5, 34.5 and 35.5 s. Full arrangement, lead back in.

sections.name: end sting
sections.direction: Final hit and held A-minor chord exactly at 36.5 s, drums stop. One last short accent at 38.75 s ("À vous de jouer"). Ring out and be fully silent by 41.0 s.

sfx.name: whoosh
sfx.description: Short, fast, airy swipe whoosh for a card sliding past, no tonal content, dry.

sfx.name: whoosh_long
sfx.description: Longer soft cinematic whoosh / air swell, smooth rise and fall. Also played reversed as a suck-in right before big hits.

sfx.name: impact
sfx.description: Heavy cinematic trailer hit: tight punchy transient with a deep sub-bass boom tail, dry, no melody.

sfx.name: impact_light
sfx.description: Small snappy punch / thump for a word or number slamming on screen, short tail.

sfx.name: riser
sfx.description: Tension riser: rising noise and pitch sweep that builds steadily and stops abruptly at its very end (no tail, no impact). It is time-stretched to end exactly on each reveal.

sfx.name: pop
sfx.description: Bright short UI pop / bubble pop, clean and playful.

sfx.name: click
sfx.description: Tiny crisp UI tick / click, very short, neutral pitch (it is re-pitched per cue).

sfx.name: ding
sfx.description: Clean positive confirmation chime, single bright bell note with a short tail (a check mark appears).

sfx.name: key
sfx.description: One single mechanical keyboard key press, close and dry (it is repeated and re-pitched for typing).

sfx.name: glitch
sfx.description: Digital glitch / tape-stop stutter: the bland template music breaks, half a second.

sfxNotes: One file per name; each is reused at all its cues (re-pitched, panned and gain-staged by build_audio.py). Leading and trailing silence is trimmed automatically. Dry sounds, no music, no voice. The riser cue times are where the riser STARTS; it is stretched to end on the next reveal.
